notes.title: Spring Sale
notes.notes:
As the first sun rays
Of the coming spring
Push back in a blaze 
Winter's cold wind

Trees start sprouting
Buds of green life
So does the search begin
For Taiki's wife

This time, although
At a reduced cost
Blessings from Lord Gaben
And his admirable host!

notes.title: Widescreen Support arrives!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We've finally added widescreen support for (probably) all possible aspect ratios! Let us know if you still have issues with yours!
[*] Other minor bug fixes (dev features were previously still enabled, we have no idea how we let that slip through)
[/list]

P.S.: Some content based on images (like level transitions or the main menu) will still have black borders, due to their static nature. The in-game experience will fully support widescreen, though!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1.0.1[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the option to [spoiler]take your own life[/spoiler] at the end of the game would not trigger correctly and freeze the game.
[*] Fixed a bug when sometimes, the checkpoint after [spoiler]dying 3 times[/spoiler] would be incorrectly set to a different location.
[*] Solved an issue where story information was revealed to the player in certain situations, even if the player did not satisfy the requirements needed.
[*] Minor story consistency adjustments.
[/list]

notes.title: Another Chance is out!
notes.notes:
The day has finally come! After months of development and polish, it is now up to you to save Naomi (and maybe even the world?).

Dive headfirst into Taiki's story, a worried husband doing his best to reunite with his wife Naomi, traversing his town, mysteriously besieged by alien invaders. On your way you will encounter various residents of the city. Choosing to help them will grant you with items which you can use further down the line. But be careful! Time is crucial during an apocalypse, and every minute spent is one more minute Taiki is separated from Naomi. It is up to you to decide whether taking your time is better than ignoring everything in your path and rushing through.

We are very excited for the launch, Another Chance being our first ever commercial game. It is quite daunting, and we are super stoked to have witnessed it grow and evolve this much! The lessons we learned during development are invaluable, both in a professional context and in our daily lives. 

For those early birds amongst you, we have a launch discount of -20% going on, so grab it while it's hot! We hope you have fun!

If you have any questions, feedback or bug reports, send 'em all to our email address: ootbs.outoftheboxstudios@gmail.com
(or comment on this post ːsteamhappyː)

[b]IMPORTANT INFO:[/b]
Another Chance is only compatible with 16:9 resolutions for now. Implementing widescreen support is our top priority for the next patch!
